# proxmox_backup_jobs (Data Source)

Lists cluster backup jobs from `/cluster/backup`, sorted by job id. An unset `node` returns all jobs, a set one only the jobs of that node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_backup_jobs" "node1" {
  node = "node1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Restrict the result to one node.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `jobs` (Attributes List) Matching backup jobs, sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `all` (Boolean)
- `comment` (String)
- `compress` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `exclude_vmids` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `mode` (String)
- `next_run` (Number)
- `node` (String)
- `pool` (String)
- `schedule` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `vmids` (String)
